CheckTitle: Check if RDS instances have multi-AZ enabled
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks that RDS DB instances are deployed across multiple Availability Zones.
Risk: Single-AZ databases suffer extended downtime and potential data loss during an AZ outage.

Recommendation.Text: Enable Multi-AZ for production RDS instances.

Notes: Not a numbered CIS AWS 3.0 control; mapped to the RDS section (2.3.2) as the nearest control.
